task_title: Persist full release sweep RunStats telemetry

plan_review.notes: Approved with changes. Adopted: validate complete payloads at runtime through normalizeFunSessions plus exact count; reject preexisting meta during release enrichment; preserve full wallTimeMs but document that only gameplay fields are deterministic and avoid byte-equality claims; use a real runHeadless-produced RunStats sample in focused tests before expanding to 600; retain compact index and note its full-file parse cost as a future optimization, not scope expansion. No different architecture warranted.

independent_grade.notes: The change correctly extracts and types the baseline telemetry enrichment logic into its own module. Data validation through normalizeFunSessions and JSON roundtrip serialization is highly robust and prevents silent corruption. Testing covers both in-memory logic and the actual deploy.yml integration. The scope is disciplined, leaving no unrelated footprint, and the code complies fully with repository policies.
